title: CRUD Operations in SQL
description: CRUD stands for Create, Read, Update, and Delete. These operations allow you to manage data stored inside database tables.

content.definition: A table is a structured collection of related data stored in rows and columns.

content.rows: Each row represents a single record (one person).
content.columns: Each column represents a property such as name, city, or age.

content.definition: An SQL query is a command used to interact with the database to create, read, update, or delete data.
CREATE is used to define tables and insert data into them.

person_table.query: CREATE TABLE person (id INT, full_name VARCHAR(100), city VARCHAR(100), age INT);
insert_data: INSERT INTO person (id, full_name, city, age) VALUES (1, 'Rahul Meena', 'Udaipur', 22);
INSERT INTO person (id, full_name, city, age) VALUES (2, 'Kavita Joshi', 'Indore', 25);
INSERT INTO person (id, full_name, city, age) VALUES (3, 'Amit Sharma', 'Jaipur', 28);

student_table.query: CREATE TABLE students (student_id INT, name VARCHAR(100), class VARCHAR(10), marks INT);

driver_table.query: CREATE TABLE drivers (driver_id INT, driver_name VARCHAR(100), vehicle_type VARCHAR(50), city VARCHAR(50));

content.definition: READ is used to retrieve data from a table using SELECT queries.

queries.description: Fetches all columns and rows from the person table.
Fetches only selected columns from the person table.

content.definition: UPDATE is used to modify existing records in a table.
content.query: UPDATE person SET city = 'England' WHERE full_name = 'Rahul Meena';

content.definition: DELETE is used to remove records from a table.
content.query: DELETE FROM person WHERE full_name = 'Amit Sharma';
